outputs.name: Effective Skill Tier
outputs.description: Skill Tier clamped to 0-6 for this preview. Overcharge is excluded.

outputs.name: Cooldown factor (× base)
outputs.description: Relative cooldown factor from Skill Haste plus Skill Efficiency, counted once each. Uses the inverse-speed estimate: 100% combined haste halves cooldown. A nonpositive speed factor yields zero. No base cooldown is applied; excludes skill-specific tier cooldown scaling, mods, Expertise, timing, resets and overcharge.

outputs.name: Estimated Damage
outputs.description: Community level-40 PvE estimate from Skill List!C88:J88 (TU27 workbook). Base 26,545; uses the selected tier curve, modeled bonuses and skill amplification. Source values and stacking need live-game verification. Excludes unreviewed skill mods, Overcharge, target armor/health/out-of-cover bonuses, resistances, DPS and unmodeled procs. Existing current-buff assumptions apply to both skill previews. Installed Expertise adds 1 percentage point per grade to the tier damage pool, separately from global Skill Damage. Effect source: Skill Info!R20:R21. This aggregation is a community-based inference requiring live-game verification. Generic damage upgrades do not change separate Burn/Bleed channels; the explicitly sourced Burn Sticky upgrade changes Burn only. The fixed observed damage mod adds to this ordinary tier pool only. Other skills and global stats are unaffected; stacking with Expertise remains an estimate.
outputs.formula: 26545 * (1 + curve('skill_assault_turret_damage_tiers', min(6, max(0, floor(skill_tier)))) + skill_mod_damage + skill_upgrade_rank * 0.01) * max(0, 1 + effective_skill_damage) * max(0, 1 + total_skill_damage) * skill_damage_multiplier

outputs.name: Estimated Ordinary Cooldown (s)
outputs.description: Community level-40 ordinary PvE cooldown reference from Skill List!C85:J85 (TU27 workbook). Base 25s, divided by one plus Skill Haste and Skill Efficiency counted once. Only explicitly reviewed tier Skill Haste enters the additive haste pool; dashed entries contribute zero. Nonpositive speed yields zero as an invalid-boundary estimate, not readiness. Excludes charge refill, skill mods, skill Expertise, Overcharge, timers, use/cancellation/destruction, deployment delays and actual resets. Existing conditional reset capability remains separate. Source baselines and stacking require live verification.

outputs.name: Estimated Skill Health
outputs.description: Community level-40 PvE skill-health reference from Skill List!C87:J87 (TU27 workbook). Armor cores and shield-specific Health do not scale this variant. This is capacity, not current health, mitigation, regeneration or destruction prediction. No unreviewed skill mods, skill Expertise, Overcharge or combat events. Source values and bonus stacking need live verification. The fixed observed health mod adds to this ordinary tier pool only. Other skills and global stats are unaffected; stacking with Expertise remains an estimate.

outputs.name: Estimated Duration Reference (s)

Source values and stacking require live verification. Fixed observed same-effect mods add locally before the existing separate gear factors. outputs.name: Installed Expertise Damage Bonus Reference
outputs.description: Installed grade on this exact variant, 0-30. Source Skill Info!R20:R21 (TU27): +1% Damage per grade. Estimated effect included in: Estimated Damage. Does not simulate proficiency, account eligibility or upgrade costs. This is the source increment, not a separate multiplier on the final estimate or a claim about caps.
